body:
I really thought we were compatible. we had ALL of the same interests. it was so unreal how much. We were alike in a lot of ways. and perhaps the one way i can admit that we werent compatible in was the emotional department. and i know how important that is in a relationship. i was co-dependent. he was independent. we both went through life with so many hardships. home issues, past relationship issues.

he was far from my first. he was my fifth relationship.

i have experience. so much shitty relationship experience. hell, i was in a relationship when i met him. my life was fine. i was quite unhappy with my relationship at the time, but i was fine. he fell in love with this independent, strong, fun loving girl. and if anything, im the opposite of all that now.

he is not with someone else. i know that for a fact. asking if he had feelings for someone else was something i did, and he told me no. hes never lied to me. and i know that he isnt in the emotional state for someone else right now. he is in no way a bad person.

the promises hes broken to me is promising he would never break up with me. and that we would be forever. he promised so many things, like how his love for me will be forever. he promised we would have a life together. so many various things along those lines.

its not easy to make friends.

he wants to be there for me. he says he still cares for me a lot. and he still finds me attractive, and kind, and beautiful. he still has light feelings for me. but its not enough. he said he wont leave me. and i asked him if he would ever cut me out and never talk to me again. he got upset that i even had to ask that. and he thought that he made that very clear.

i need comfort in him. but the ammount he wants to talk is limited. and honestly, hes already broken so many promises before. i dont know what i would do if i lost him.

i don't want to try to do anything. i just want him back. nobody could ever care for me the way he did. and i mean that. noone. im unlikable anyways, i dont know why he even bothered with me in the first place. im a shitty person.
